1531-4279-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-4279-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1116-4279-4699--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-4279-4699--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4881-6909-7223-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7223-8198.easyPrerequisites: Stalactite Dagger is attached to Carnage.
4881-6909-7223-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

5170-5256-6132-7574.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1662-2092-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
1662-2092-4954.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Karoo and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a slumber counter on it

3201-3457-7791.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Arixmethes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Arixmethes.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5645-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

643-4302-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4302-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

2894-4451-6033-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2894-4451-6033-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Greater Mossdog. Then, the draw will be replaced by Greater Mossdog's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Greater Mossdog from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3025-3967-4681-5170.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-7061.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-4120-7061.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3693-4120-7061.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2511-3234-3293-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2511-3234-3293-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat
2511-3234-3293-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

431-2557-4365-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-4365-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-5147-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-5147-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

654-5003-6644-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6283-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-6283-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Dazzling Angel indestructible.
2034-3490-6283-6719.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2292-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2438-3602--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2438-3602--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1799-2579-2701-4050-4823.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeless Witness, adding one mana of any color.
When Timeless Witness dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Timeless Witness from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Timeless Witness from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

2617-3821-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one mana-producing land.
2617-3821-4613-5917.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake token's trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
2617-3821-4613-5917.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using step 1 instead.

2054-2440-2714-5105.description:
Cast Siege-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Siege-Gang Commander enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander trigger, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblin tokens enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times.
Resolve all four Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {16}.
Activate Urn of Godfire four times by paying {8}, adding {W}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Siege-Gang Commander by paying {C}{R} and sacrificing itself.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {C}{W} to return Siege-Gang Commander from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander activated ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

997-2452-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
997-2452-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

864-2963-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant

3354-5008.notablePrerequisites:
Raving Dead does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Raving Dead.
3354-5008.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Raving Dead.
Raving Dead triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

224-3470-4165-4967.notablePrerequisites:
Wind Zendikon attached to Thawing Glaciers.
Thawing Glaciers does not have summoning sickness.
224-3470-4165-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Coralhelm.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

147-1878-4050-4558.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
147-1878-4050-4558.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning either Dualcaster Mage or any other nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, targeting Jeska's Will.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, creating a copy of Jeska's Will.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2510-3227-3448.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3227-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
